newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 10.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - After a 25-year career as a Paramount Pictures executive, Barry London is stepping down as vice chairman of the motion picture group and segueing into a production deal at the studio.
HOLLYWOOD - The ratings for the 48th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards telecast on ABC were up about 17 percent over last year.

NEW YORK - David Geffen has asked Joel Schumacher to direct the long-awaited bigscreen adaptation of "Dreamgirls", the Broadway musical that was the last to be directed and choreographed by Michael Bennett before his death.

NEW YORK (Variety) - In one of its biggest movie output deals ever, HBO will sell 12 of its original pictures to Turner Broadcasting System Inc's TBS cable television network for about $300,000 a title. Spokesmen for HBO and TBS declined to comment.
